caption: The drawing depicts a single figure positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The figure appears to be a person with medium brown skin, dressed in a multi-layered, historical or theatrical costume that combines shades of gray, white, green, gold, and red. The headdress is green with a yellow band, resembling feathers or leaves standing upright. The clothing consists of a gray tunic or jacket with gold trim and oversized, puffed sleeves, along with a white sash running diagonally across the chest, secured with a gold chain. There is a red belt or waistband at the midsection and green, leaf-like flaps at the top of the brownish shorts. The shorts have gold vertical stripes and trim. The figure's left arm, partly obscured by a sleeve, holds a small brown object, while the right hand holds a brownish item at shoulder height. The legs are covered in white stockings marked with small brown spots, one of which is bound with a red garter above the knee. The footwear consists of pointed shoes, yellow with dark brown tips. The figure's expression is neutral, and the stance is upright with one leg slightly forward, suggesting movement. The image is rendered in a realistic style with careful shading and detail, and there is no visible background or surroundings.
title: Indian Woman
